title: Dental PPO Plans Appeals Desk Guide: Amount in Dispute on Second-Level Post-Service Appeals
content:
**Rule.** When a member of the Dental PPO Plans files a second-level post-service appeal, on a group enrollment, of a claim-line decision upheld at the first level, the claim-appeal rule fixes the amount in dispute the member states. It applies to a line dated on or after the date the enrollment changed to a plan that covers the line's service class while the plan held before did not, on a plan that does not bank rollover dollars, on an account with no more than three enrolled persons. Any other appeal states no amount under this rule.

**When the amount is fixed.** The amount in dispute on a claim appeal is fixed only after the decision under appeal no longer stands denied for the new waiting period that followed a plan change, where the person's earlier Cascade DHMO coverage has already served that waiting period. Said the other way round: while the decision under appeal still stands as that waiting-period denial, the amount in dispute is not yet fixed.

**The filing tool: `file_claim_appeal_86dbcb40`.**

*Capability.* The member files, in person, an internal post-service appeal of one Dental PPO claim-line decision. One call records the filing on the member's enrollment with today's filing date, filed by the member, outcome pending and the stated decision due date; for a second-level filing it is linked to the first-level decision being appealed. The amount in dispute stated by the member becomes part of the appeal's reference number and is printed on the acknowledgment. Afterwards the appeal shows as pending review and the member can quote its reference number.

*How it is invoked.* This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `file_claim_appeal_86dbcb40` and hands it over, and the customer themselves files the appeal with it.

*Parameters.*
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dental_plan_id` | Reference number of the member's dental PPO enrollment the appealed decision was made under, as returned by the dental enrollment lookup | Identifier |
| `dental_claim_line_id` | Reference number of the appealed claim line, as shown by the dental claim-line lookup; for a `second_level` filing, the claim line the first-level filing names (shown on the appeal lookup), even where that line has since been reprocessed | Identifier |
| `appeal_level` | Internal review level of this filing | `first_level` when the line has not been appealed at any level yet; `second_level` when a decided appeal of the same line is taken to the next internal level (group enrollments only) |
| `original_appeal_id` | For a `second_level` filing, reference number of the first-level decision record being appealed, as shown by the dental appeal lookup | Identifier; an empty string for a `first_level` filing |
| `decision_due_date` | Date by which the appeal must be decided | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount_in_dispute` | Plan payment the member contests on the appealed decision | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when nothing is contested |

*Return.* On success, a text record with `status` ("appeal_filed"), `dental_appeal_id` (appeal reference number), `dental_claim_line_id` (line appealed), `appeal_level` (as filed), `filed_date` and `decision_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `amount_in_dispute` (USD, 2 decimals).
